# Auriga Drive

## Electrical ratings

Auriga Drive is a 900 V silicon-carbide traction inverter rated for 320 kW continuous output.

Its measured peak efficiency is 99.1% at 180 kW and a 650 V DC input.

## Thermal system

The liquid-cooling inlet limit is 65 °C at the continuous-power operating point.
